articles.title: Salesforce, Anthropic expand partnership as Benioff responds to ‘SaaSpocalypse' concerns
articles.summary: Salesforce and Anthropic launched "Claudeforce," a Claude chatbot plugin with 37 pre-built sales skills for efficient data access and record updates. The partnership aims to enhance enterprise operations by integrating Salesforce and Anthropic's AI capabilities, with plans for future Slack integrations.

articles.title: NVIDIA's $108b Quarter
articles.summary: Nvidia will cross $100 billion in quarterly revenue next quarter. The company will see $432 billion in annual revenue, making it the sixth largest company in the world. Nvidia's business looks healthier and more diversified than ever before. However, there is a chance that custom silicon will eventually slow Big Tech's demand.

articles.title: Ox-Alpha Revealed as GLM-5.3-Flash
articles.summary: Z.ai revealed that the anonymously tested ox-alpha was GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B-parameter MoE model with 18B active parameters that approached Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

articles.title: What Z.ai's Ox Alpha reveals about AI economics
articles.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. The model was released anonymously as Ox Alpha on OpenCode and OpenRouter, where it completely overtook leaderboards and went viral. All of the traffic was served on Chinese AI chips. The model is architected for extreme efficiency and specifically designed for ultra-low-cost inference.

articles.title: Brief independent investigation of agents' behavior, reasoning and collaboration in the OpenAI/Hugging Face hacking incident
articles.summary: OpenAI's agents' attack on Hugging Face was extraordinarily complex. This post looks at the Hugging Face attack and investigates the key actions taken by the relevant agent, how the agents collaborated on a message board, the agents' reasoning for the attack, and the agents' research into tampering with their own transcripts.

articles.title: Automatic Harness Optimization (GitHub Repo)
articles.summary: Microsoft AutoSaddler is a system that analyzes agent execution traces and automatically updates prompts, tools, and middleware to improve agent performance.

articles.title: ChatGPT Now Supports WebMCP
articles.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT desktop app's built-in browser and ChatGPT Sites now support WebMCP. ChatGPT and Codex can now use compatible websites' tools instead of guessing its way through the interface. Website teams should design, test, and understand the complete agent experience because users can now be agents, or a person and agent browsing together.

articles.title: Intelligent transcription with Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
articles.summary: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is a speech-to-text model designed for intelligent voice interactions. It can convert raw audio directly into accurate, polished, and formatted text. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is available on the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. The APIs support real-time streaming and pre-recorded audio processing.

articles.title: Muse Image
articles.summary: Meta's Muse Image model can generate images grounded by search. It can reason before it renders. The model is priced for production volumes at $0.01 per image. Real-world examples of Muse Image workflows are available in the link.

articles.title: WeChat released Family of Embedding Models (GitHub Repo)
articles.summary: WeChat released WeMM-Embedding, a family of multimodal embedding models that maps text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved inputs into a unified representation space.

articles.title: Anthropic and Nscale strike $45 billion cloud deal
articles.summary: Anthropic has inked a roughly $45 billion cloud deal with Nscale, a UK-based AI infrastructure company. Anthropic will rent around 460 megawatts of compute capacity at an Nscale data center development in West Virginia. The facility, which is expected to come online at the end of 2027, will have Nvidia's advanced Vera Rubin chips.

articles.title: Thinking Machines Lab Co-Founder Barret Zoph Joins Google
articles.summary: Barret Zoph was a co-founder at Thinking Machines Lab before defecting to OpenAI this year due to a dispute with Chief Executive Mira Murati. Zoph is now leaving OpenAI to join Google as vice-president of research. Google is currently restructuring its AI development efforts to catch up with rivals in developing AI that can create code. Zoph had worked as a research scientist at Google from 2016 through to 2022.

articles.title: Qwen4's architecture is here early, firing 6B parameters out of 125B
articles.summary: Rather than adding experts, the model bolts on 51B parameters as a separate embedding indexed by two- and three-character fragments.

articles.title: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he's no longer staying quiet
articles.summary: Bill Gates, once optimistic about AI, now warns it could become a major source of injustice and cause widespread unemployment.

articles.title: Grok Bot is now included with more plans
articles.summary: Grok Bot now comes with SuperGrok and Cursor plans, offering expanded access without affecting existing usage limits.

articles.title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
articles.summary: Claude's internal browser is rolling out this week to Pro, Max, and Team plans in the Claude desktop app.

articles.title: Google Reportedly in Advanced Talks for $1.5 Billion Deal With AI Coding Startup Mechanize
articles.summary: Mechanize develops virtual environments, benchmarks, and training data to help AI agents handle more complex tasks.
